cands.bio: Democrat from Bessemer who has represented Alabama House District 56 since November 2022. Former teacher and head boys basketball coach in the Bessemer City School District. Attorney since 2012, now a partner at Maxwell Tillman Law Firm in Birmingham, practicing criminal defense, juvenile law and personal injury.
cands.gaps: We found no documented positions from Tillman on data centers, development, homestead property taxes, foreign or investor land buying, immigration or H-1B, abortion, guns, policing or school choice. His campaign site lists topic headings such as reducing gun violence, criminal justice reform, mental health and education funding, but gives no specific positions or actions. Ballotpedia's list of bills he sponsored did not load, so we could not confirm any particular bill. We found no news coverage of controversies, no foreign ties, and no endorsements; Ballotpedia says it identified none for 2026. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey. No independent source confirms his upbringing beyond his campaign site and Ballotpedia's birthplace and high school details.
